description: Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your Friday evening in Lisbon? Whether you live here, recently moved to the city, or you're simply passing through while travelling, you're very welcome to join us! International Friends Lisbon is a growing community of local Portuguese and international people who come together regularly. Come alone or bring your friends — either way, you'll be welcome! ❤️ 🃏 LET'S MAKE SOCIALISING EASIER! Walking into a busy social event can sometimes feel a little awkward - so we make it easier! We run fun matching and connection activities to get people moving around, talking and mixing with different people. Nothing complicated - just a bit of fun to get conversations started! 😄 🎁 FUN COMMUNITY RAFFLE We also have a fun raffle draw during the evening, adding a little extra excitement to the night! 🕖 COME EARLY & ENJOY THE WHOLE EVENING Doors open at 7:00 PM, and we strongly recommend arriving early. Most of our attendees stay till 1:00 AM. You're welcome to stay and enjoy the music until 3:00 AM. ❤️ FRIENDSHIP & COMMUNITY FIRST We want our events to be somewhere people feel comfortable coming back to week after week, seeing familiar faces and becoming part of the community.
